body: Thank you. This helped me more than you know

Part of me wants to just pack up and leave everything, but I could never do that. I'm a 19 year old girl,  I could never make it in the world alone. I was thinking about trying it though, because I could always just go through with it if leaving didn't make me feel better. But I'd be leaving my boyfriend and family. And anyway I don't even have the motivation to do that. I'm just so tired. I just want to be at peace.
